_about: Local image-to-3D models evaluated for Mode 3. Requirements researched 2026-11-24 from official READMEs/model cards (see sources). VRAM figures are the vendors' defaults for one image; verify on your hardware. 'supported_by_skill' = an install+run adapter exists in scripts/ai3d.
_pytorch_note: PyTorch removed Maxwell/Pascal (cc 5.x/6.x) from its CUDA 12.8+ wheels; CUDA 12.6 wheels (last with cc 5.0+) end with PyTorch 2.14. CUDA 13.x needs cc >= 7.5 (Turing). Old drivers cap the usable CUDA version (see hwprobe max_cuda).

triposr.name: TripoSR
triposr.texture: vertex colours (texture bake optional in upstream run.py)
triposr.mesh_quality: medium: smooth single-object meshes, soft detail, back side hallucinated
triposr.inference_time: <1 s on A100; CPU: measured by this skill (see tests/TESTING.md)
triposr.install_complexity: medium (torch + transformers; torchmcubes needs a C++ build - the skill's adapter replaces it with PyMCubes/scikit-image)
